query:
SELECT r.id, r.firstName, r.lastName, r.email, p.id as pkg_id, p.isActive, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, (p.totalHours - p.usedHours) as remaining, p.endDate
FROM residents r
LEFT JOIN packages p ON p.residentId = r.id AND p.isActive = 1
WHERE r.isActive = 1 AND r.isDeleted = 0
ORDER BY r.id;
